assertionResults.title: Worker cards with avatar and call button
assertionResults.reason: WorkerCard uses a border-only card, 44px circular avatar with labour/stone-5 active-state colors, a 7px status dot, and a 36px primary-tinted call button.

references.details: Active/inactive avatar colors are hardcoded to labour purple #7A5E8E and stone-5 #A89E92.
Card uses the mist-1 surface with a 1px stone-3 border.
Avatar is 44x44 and circular, status dot is 7x7, and the call button is 36x36 with a primary-tinted background.

assertionResults.title: Three-segment control
assertionResults.reason: The outer shell matches the mist-2 pill with 3px padding, but the active segment itself uses mist-1 (#F7F3ED) instead of white and Android selected labels stay at medium weight instead of 600.

references.details: Workers screen wraps the control in a mist-2 pill with borderRadius.full and padding: 3.
SegmentedControl uses colors.surface[200] for the container and colors.surface[100] for the selected segment background.
Selected label weight is semibold only on iOS; Android forces fontWeight.medium.
surface[100] is #F7F3ED and surface[200] is #EEE7DD, confirming the active fill is not white.

assertionResults.title: Full/Half/Absent toggle buttons
assertionResults.reason: The mark-attendance view now has per-worker pill toggles with the correct green/amber/red fills, but the controls do not include the matching dot indicators required by the contract.

references.details: Screen renders worker rows with Full, Half, and Absent pill controls.
Buttons use borderRadius.pill and state colors #4F7A5A, #C58A2B, and #B84C3A.
Each state control renders only a Text label, with no matching dot element.
Theme success/warning/error tokens resolve to the expected green, amber, and red values.

assertionResults.title: Date navigator
assertionResults.reason: The mark-attendance screen implements a bordered date navigator with previous/next arrow buttons, a centered semibold date label, and explicit date-navigation handlers.

references.details: handleDateNavigation updates the selected date for previous/next actions.
Navigator row uses a bordered card layout with left/right arrow buttons and a centered date label.

assertionResults.title: Mark All Present button
assertionResults.reason: The sticky primary CTA is present and full width, but it uses borderRadius.md (16px) instead of the required 12px radius.

references.details: Always-visible sticky CTA renders the Mark All Present label with primary background and white text.
borderRadius.md is defined as 16, which is larger than the required 12px radius.
